name: manual_8efd05
claim: The destructive-command safety hook matches the literal command text anywhere in a Bash call: inside a heredoc, a quoted python string, a grep pattern or a commit-message body, not only in the command that executes. Refines lesson_85ed00727240. When a document or script legitimately has to contain the text of a hard reset or a lease push, create or edit it with the Edit or Write tools (the hook watches Bash only), phrase searches as a regex that does not spell the literal, and word commit messages as hard reset. Never obfuscate the command to evade the hook; the block is a stop sign for the destructive action itself.

decisions.notes: Hit four times on 2026-10-14 in orama-system PR 404 work: a grep pattern, a python heredoc with a doc replacement, and a documentation example each blocked an otherwise harmless command. Refines lesson_85ed00727240 and lesson_87be43ee3c1d.
